The '''Wornal sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], neighboring the [[Sombure sector/Legends|Sombure sector]].

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Wornal sector was located in [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] Space, but [[Bomis Koori IV]] was one of the last [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] stronghold.<ref name="TEA" />

Under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Wornal sector was controlled by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Eyrgen]]. After the substantial defeat of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Eyrgen formed his own empire in the region.

Just some months later, he was defeated by [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Utoxx Prentioch]] of the Sombure sector and the Wornal sector was integrated in [[Prentioch's Dominion]].<ref name="TEA" />

The Wornal sector was [[Siege of Bomis Koori|liberated]] by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] when Prentioch was defeated in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

The sector was spared during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].<ref name="TEA" />
